stage: S6 Qwen3-8B greedy decode, TP=1 vs TP=2
basis: S4 measured 73.8 us/layer for a 8704x5120 bf16 GEMV plus a 10 KiB all-reduce; S1 measured 44.3 GB/s cross-card and S2-sync 8.3-8.7 us per 10 KiB collective. Per-token weight traffic here is about 8.2 GB per card at TP=2 and 16.4 GB at TP=1. These are ESTIMATES from those components, not measurements of this model.
correctness: Greedy tokens from TP=1 and TP=2 must agree for at least the first 32 decode steps, and the first-step logits must agree within bf16 tolerance; a mismatch above the tolerance is a failed engine, not a performance result. An independent CPU reference from Hugging Face transformers is generated once and compared to TP=1.
scope: One prompt, greedy decode, bs=1, one graph per card, native same-stream NCCL for the two per-layer all-reduces. Not a serving engine: no paged KV, no batch, no sampling, no prefill optimization. Weights are bf16, so this is not the 27B int4 projection.
decision_rule: TP2 >= 1.4x TP1 on this box and day is S6's pass criterion. Below 1.35x, inspect the fixed tax before any further stage; between 1.35x and 1.4x, report the number and do not round up.
